tasks.title: Get Telegram Bot Token
tasks.subtitle: Needed for the sniper bot to run
steps: Open Telegram and search for @BotFather
Send the message: /newbot
Pick a name for your bot (e.g. Big Brain Ape Sniper)
Pick a username ending in 'bot' (e.g. BigBrainApeSniper_bot)
BotFather will reply with a token that looks like 123456:ABC-DEF...
Copy that token and send it to me here in Telegram
